video.agency.evidence: [影魔·codex] 图1第2行（2.00–3.75秒），我被围攻时虽逐渐收暗火光，但看不清受击震动或针对攻击者的反应；第3行第3–8格（4.50–5.75秒）姿态变化很小，无法确认我仍在持续收紧、下沉蓄力，存在原地停等的疑点。第4行第3格（6.50秒）才明显出现灵魂柱，也晚于规格5.3–6秒的释放拍。不能确认我的挨打反应与行动连续性，按要求判fail。；[树人·claude] Image 1. In the 0–1.5s cells the treants (me) converge on him from all sides and the charge reads clearly. In the 1.5–4.0s cells we surround him, and the sparks on his shoulder at 3.0 and 4.0 suggest we are hitting him. But in the 4.25–6.0s cells the cluster around him looks almost the same frame to frame. I can't find a clear arm swing or the roughly 0.7s strike rhythm, so we may have stopped hitting or be standing in place, which would be a 'treants stop attacking' violation. The release also comes late. The pillars appear at about 6.25–6.5, not 5.3, and they seem to rise in place around us instead of pushing out from his feet. In the 6.75–7.5 cells several treants are still upright and seem to be moving among the pillars, for example near the lower left at 7.25 and 7.5. We are not dropping the instant the ring passes. We go down slowly and late, which hits the negatives 'treants keep walking among the pillars' and 'treants fall only after a while'. The resolution is low, so I can't confirm the strikes; I judge fail.

video.readability.evidence: [audience·claude] Read as a first-time viewer, the sheet roughly says: a fire demon in the centre (0–1.75s) is surrounded by a mob of dark creatures. They close in from 2.0 to 4.0s, and from 4.25 to 6.25s the demon is buried with its fire glow gone. At 6.5s (row 4, cell 3) dark pillars suddenly come up all over the field with dust, and by 7.0–7.75s the creatures are mostly gone. At 8.0s the demon lights up with arms spread, and from 9.0 to 11.75s it stands among bodies on the ground. The result (the mob is dead, the demon wins) is visible. Who cast the skill and how it hit is not clear: (1) at the moment the pillars appear (6.25→6.5s) the demon has no glow and no casting pose, and it only lights up at 8.0s, after the pillars are already there. Cause and effect are reversed, so I can't be sure the demon cast the pillars. It could be the environment or another force. (2) The pillars are grey-black and don't match the demon's fire. They jump from almost nothing at 6.25s to fully grown at 6.5s with no build-up, no trail from the demon, and no visible impact on any creature. The creatures just disappear into dust (6.75–7.25s), so 'what hit whom' can't be pointed to. (3) From 4.25 to 6.25s the demon is dark and swallowed by the mob, and it is hard to tell whether it is being overwhelmed or charging up. (4) The whole thing is a distant wide shot with very small figures, and the skill is mostly grey dust and dark pillars. It doesn't deliver the Vision's 'flashier skill', so I'm unsure and judging it a fail.
